Cloud plan thread brief. Build advisor (4), Oct 26, against claude-settings main 7ce2d89 (or newer).
Plan only: build nothing, open no PR. Write to the roadmap branch only (pull before each write;
only Triage the roadmap (3) republishes). Read other repos, never push to them.

## Rulings and inputs (read o8's note on the roadmap branch first)

- shiv, Oct 21: the page is a current record, not a log.

- Open, do not decide: where each worker's live state comes from (name the options, pick one, park
  it for shiv).
- Inputs in flight, name them, do not wait: o16's project-ops package (#618, batch #629),
  o15's tracked homes for tasks and rulings, o2's layout file (lint/layout.json), this roadmap's
  build.py and its upkeep list (c55, c72).

## Task

Write plans/o8-living-roadmap-plan.md (cap 2 pages): what the /roadmap skill reads in a repo
(each item from its one home, via layout.json; unknown when unreadable), the page layout per the
logbook pick, how a merge updates a step's status, how it ports to each repo (yes or no per repo,
with a reason), and the build lanes in order with a check that proves each. Measure, do not guess:
read banchi, q_max and home-app to see which homes exist today.

## Report

Cap 15 lines: Done, Deviations, Next (the lanes), the parked question for shiv, and "Port to other
repos: yes or no, and why". Send the plan path to "Advise the claude-settings build (4)"
(cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2EyHwiKacoTT56k4JHuc2RT).
note: Shows, per repo: every debt and note, your feedback items and where each went, the repo's plans, each session's plan, and open PRs and branches. The page reads each item from its one home, stores no copy, shows when it last read, and marks what it could not read as unknown. Needs feedback items homed in the repo first. Session pages (live, o10) sit under the repo page (lasting). Your idea, Oct 22: a live view with pixel-art workers showing each one's state; it draws from records sessions already write, read when the page opens, with no new watcher (c26). Where each worker's live state comes from is still open. Your rule, Oct 21: the page is a current record, not a log; this roadmap's own upkeep now runs through c55 (the triage thread and build.py's upkeep list), which a repo page can copy. Your pick, Oct 22: B, logbook (claude.ai/artifact/9H4NgQdoNNhU939mXojVv9), with your UI changes started; A and C unused. Each themes per repo from one block of tokens. Merged in from o7 (triage, Oct 26): the page also shows the repo's map, the session-board mod's progress and compliance-check scores, as one health view. Linked: o16 (any repo can adopt this project's way of working) packages the process this page serves.
title: Give every repo a living roadmap page
why: The process behind this page, made repeatable: audit the repo, turn the findings into phased steps with a plain why and an ask for each, publish one page per repo, and update it in place as lanes land. A /roadmap skill in claude-settings would build it from docs/plans and docs/debts, and the merge step would tick off the steps it completes. It pairs with the health view: health shows how the repo is, the roadmap shows what's next.
